github_surges.description: Let AI agents use your phone, with you in the loop.
Let AI agents operate a real iPhone. Local MCP server and agent, no jailbreak, no extra hardware.
STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.
See and operate an unmodified iPhone from a Linux PC: AirPlay mirror in, Bluetooth HID mouse/keyboard out, plus a CLI and skill for agents.
Headless 3D and VFX engine for agents. Research preview.
One VM for every project. An isolated sandbox with your project’s toolchain, ready for you or a coding agent to start coding
A browser extension for easy on-device translation with a local LLM (PLaMo). Private, free, no server needed.
NVIDIA Auto Ontology's semantic layer and a personal knowledge base as an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients. No LLM API key needed.
Turn one image of anything into a 3D sculpt measured against that image: registered views, map-fitting passes, Blender replay and timelapse. A skill for coding agents.
Talk to a Hermes Agent profile through Home Assistant Assist
